mandatory_release_checks: All 27 required inventory entries have complete source provenance and tests
Three independently authored hole manifests and compiled collision/green geometry exist
Actual tree and flag objects use source-informed separate 3D collision envelopes; no sprite-derived hitbox assumptions
Human player can tee off, aim, select club, capture authentic meter input, hit sand/water/tree/flag, putt and hole out on each hole
All code8, code9, code10, OOB and hazard branches settle and return control correctly
3-hole scoring and deterministic replay work over interruption, restart and PRNG
Commercial Godot scenes render approved assets while C++ remains sole simulation authority
Portrait standard Android, Fold closed/open and multiple render refresh rates preserve game-state outcomes
No original executable, commercial course map, sprites or audio in build
Distribution rights to source-derived engine and numerical tables legally cleared or substituted
Signed Android arm64 build and physical device QA pass

milestone_one_acceptance.criterion: Complete 27-area evidence/source inventory and reference-data integrity
Three complete independently authored approved real holes
Verified authored tree collision object mask height and deflection
Complete original style flight and rolls on three real holes across FPS
Three-click original meter scheduling input and displayed contact zones
Sand water named hazards world OOB flag cup and true ball event sequence
Code8 code9 code10 and all pause/hazard resume settle and unblock input
3-hole full public bridge loop with accurate independent hole and overall scores
PRNG deterministic save replay and interrupted gameplay recovery on all three holes
Godot real playable scenes do not duplicate C++ physics and support touch

Frozen approved Pixtee art, portrait/Fold HUD and legible world sponsor boards, plus ten production World FX acceptance checks (shaders, particles, wind/water, genuine event-driven collisions, accessibility, render performance and unchanged native trajectory).
Android arm64 release build validated normal phone Fold closed and open
Rights audit original data/source code and media commercially cleared
